defect.reproducer: ros2 launch course_bringup patrol.launch.py namespace:=robot_a subscriber_reliability:=reliable record:=false: ros2 topic list shows /robot_a/sensor_pose, ros2 topic info --verbose shows the pose_relay publisher with Reliability: BEST_EFFORT and the pose_listener subscription with Reliability: RELIABLE; timeout 5s ros2 topic echo ... --qos-reliability reliable --once prints only the incompatible QoS warning and exits with 124; pose_listener logs incompatible QoS (last policy RELIABILITY) and received 0 messages (evidence/pr05/qos-before.txt).
defect.root_cause: A best effort publisher does not offer the delivery guarantee a reliable subscription requests, so the endpoints match by topic name and type but the QoS check fails and DDS never connects them. The topic is visible in the graph, yet no message reaches the reliable subscriber.
defect.proof_after: Only the launch argument changed: subscriber_reliability:=best_effort. ros2 topic echo --qos-reliability best_effort gets a message, pose_listener receives the stream, and the stream was recorded to MCAP. The same bag replayed with config/qos-overrides.yaml (best_effort, keep_last, depth 10) again gives nothing to reliable subscribers and messages to best effort ones; ros2 bag info shows one topic /robot_a/sensor_pose (evidence/pr05/qos-after.txt, bag-metadata.yaml).
